SeaWeather is Weather Routing, Inc.’s supplemental website and mobile application that provides a suite of weather tools and information for mariners worldwide. You have access to:

• Real Time Surface Observations
• Satellite Imagery
• Radar Imagery
• 6 Hourly Global Forecast Charts for:
      - Wind Direction/Speed
      - Sea and Swell Height/Directions/Periods
      - Precipitation
      - Sea Level Pressure
      - Visibility
• Tropical Cyclone Tracker
• WRI Heavy Weather Alerts & Hazards
• Global Forecast Coverage

Weather data and forecasts are continuously received and processed in house and immediately distributed to the website and mobile application. You have complete control over the map at the tip of your finger. You can pan the map all over the world and zoom in and out.
